labels.label: excluded

evidence.quote: Previously progressed (radiological progression) on at least one approved systemic therapy for advanced melanoma

labels.note: No systemic therapy yet for metastatic disease.

labels.label: excluded

evidence.quote: Histologically or cytologically confirmed cutaneous (acral and non-acral) melanoma.
Documentation of radiological disease progression on or after the previous standard-of-care regimen.

labels.note: Melanoma cohort is cutaneous only and requires prior ICI progression.

evidence.quote: unresectable, recurrent, or metastatic non-uveal melanoma
Participants must have had documented progression during or within 12 weeks after the last dose of PD-1 checkpoint inhibition-based therapy.

labels.label: eligible

evidence.quote: Patients with confirmed diagnosis of metastatic Uveal melanoma not amenable to surgical resection.
Any exposure to immune checkpoint inhibitor (ICIs) since the time of first being diagnosed with uveal melanoma.
Has at least 1 measurable and injectable tumor of ≥ 1 cm in longest diameter

labels.note: ICI-naive metastatic uveal melanoma with measurable liver metastases.

labels.label: possibly

evidence.quote: Histologically confirmed advanced solid tumor with specific KRAS G12 mutations (dose escalation) or RAS mutations (dose optimization/expansion) identified through deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA) sequencing.
Treatment naive or have received prior standard therapy appropriate for tumor type and stage

labels.note: RAS status never tested; RAS mutation is atypical in uveal melanoma.

evidence.quote: patients with unresectable metastatic cutaneous melanoma that progressed on any prior immune checkpoint inhibitor
Must have at least one BCC or SCC tumor eligible for removal by Mohs surgery.
Have at least 5 AKs on each forearm/wrist, but no more than 10 to allow for easy monitoring
for curative intent for a known cancer diagnosis
Clinical or radiological evidence of metastatic UM
Primary local therapy completed within 120 days before C1D1/randomization.

labels.label: possibly

evidence.quote: metastatic solid tumor that has progressed on standard therapy or for which no standard therapy exist
metastatic Stage IV cutaneous melanoma, NSCLC, or RCC that has radiographically progressed

labels.note: Phase 2 is cutaneous/post-PD-1 only; phase 1 escalation possible only if no standard therapy deemed available.
